Private IPv4 FIB key, table, and hashmap layout helpers.

# Purpose
Defines the private data layout and helper functions for the `fd_fib4` IPv4 forwarding table. The file declares the `fd_fib4_key` and `fd_fib4` structures, plus inline accessors that locate the key table and hop table inside one contiguous memory block. It also defines the private hash map entry type and includes the map template used to build the internal destination-address lookup table. The helper functions at the end compute hash map capacity, probe limit, and lock count from the requested element count.
